Metadata.title: Wattly English
Metadata.description: Learn English with Wattly — inclusive lessons with teachers and AI support.

HomePage.title: Learn more, get results, progress.
HomePage.description: A proven method with total flexibility — online or in center, you choose.

Footer.tagline: Speak English with confidence — from your very first A to fluent Z.

Profile.title: Your profile
Profile.intro: Manage your Wattly identity, role and display name.
Profile.needLogin: Please sign in to view your profile.

Auth.loginIntro: Sign in to continue learning with your teacher and accessible tools.
Auth.signupIntro: Join as a learner, parent, or teacher. Inclusion is built in from the start.
Auth.name: Full name
Auth.loginFailed: Could not sign in. Check your email and password.
Auth.demoAccessHint: Pick a role — auto-fills and signs you in

Onboarding.title: Set up your learning path
Onboarding.intro: Tell us your goals and optional support preferences. You can change these anytime. We never ask for a diagnosis.
Onboarding.goalsPlaceholder: Introduce myself, order food, talk with friends…
Onboarding.supportsHint: Choose what helps you learn. You decide what teachers can see.

Dashboard.title: Your learning home
Dashboard.intro: Find a teacher, practice with AI support, and track your progress — at your pace.
Dashboard.findTeacherBody: Match with inclusive teachers by level, language, and specialization.
Dashboard.practiceBody: Short vocabulary, listening, conversation and pronunciation activities.
Dashboard.lessonsBody: Live lessons with captions, visual agendas and flexible pace.

Teachers.title: Find your teacher
Teachers.intro: Filter by specialization, language of explanation, and learning style. Sample teachers are shown for the prototype.
Teachers.profileBody: Captioned intro, specialization badges, availability and trial booking will connect here. For now this is a prototype profile screen.

Practice.title: Practice hub
Practice.intro: Every activity can be done by speaking, typing, or tapping — no forced speaking.
Practice.vocabularyBody: Picture + audio + text word practice with spaced review.
Practice.vocabularyDetail: Learn a few words at a time with pictures, audio and optional symbols. Review is short and calm.
Practice.listeningBody: Captioned clips and gentle comprehension checks.
Practice.listeningDetail: Listen with captions on. Answer by typing or tapping — take your time.
Practice.conversationBody: Patient role-play for real situations at your level.
Practice.conversationDetail: Practice ordering food or introducing yourself. Ask one question at a time. No timers, no scores.
Practice.pronunciationDetail: Try sounds when you want. Feedback is gentle and visual. You can skip speaking entirely.
